findings.external_fact: SemEval-2026 RvH-40 reports that variable and pseudoword symbolic transformations can expose latent logical reasoning otherwise suppressed by linguistic content, with 97.92% validation and 96.34% hidden-test accuracy in the reported system.
findings.repository_inference: C19 I2 role/ordinal/sentence decomposition plus hashed surface content has a strong ordinary abstraction/canonicalization explanation. I2>I1 would not uniquely attribute gain to SparkBrain persistent dynamics.

findings.external_fact: PDDL-Mind decouples state evolution from belief inference using explicit PDDL states/actions and verified transitions, reporting more than five percentage points absolute gain over prior state of the art on multiple ToM benchmarks.
findings.repository_inference: Reliable explicit state tracking is an established alternative explanation for external belief-reasoning gains; C19 needs a representation/information-matched explicit-state null before persistent dynamics can receive mechanistic credit.

findings.external_fact: BeliefTrack formalizes Contextual Belief Management with Failed Update, Failed Stay and Failed Isolation; the paper reports belief-state-reward RL reducing failure rates by 70.9% on average and representation steering by 46.1% across two tasks.
findings.repository_inference: C19 BU/BM/BREU covers update/maintain but not an independent isolation/noise axis. A future external-generalization test should measure irrelevant-evidence isolation separately without modifying current C19-v2.

findings.external_fact: Balcells et al. report Bayesian belief states linearly decodable from residual streams of six open-source LLMs across 40 HMMs with peak probe R2 0.83-0.99 and functional patching/steering effects.
findings.repository_inference: Persistent/history-conditioned functionally relevant belief-state representations are an established Transformer comparator property; persistent belief state alone cannot serve as SparkBrain novelty evidence.
